title: Nuns With Guns release 29th October
author: Romellija
selftext:
Nuns With Guns: The Last Vespers - Coming 29th October!! 

Base Price: €4.99  

10% launch discount.

Hi all, 

I've posted my game here a few times and now finally, it has a release date. It's been a long road but I'm super proud of how far the game has come. The game is designed have a fun story with some laughs along the way and doesn't take itself too seriously while still be action packed.

The game has been made with the assistance of AI in various aspects from some textures, music, models and code assistance. Happy to answer any questions, 

Wishlist now https://store.steampowered.com/app/4841200/Nuns\_With\_Guns/

comments.author: Substantial_Fish6717
comments.body:
Cool concept, but surely not gonna be release ready by end of the month, it needs at least another 6 months to be polished enough. You're missing even the proper walking animation. 

My advice,  scrap the deadline, work on it until it's ready, then release it the month after that

replies.author: Romellija
replies.body: Thanks for the feedback. Ya I'm currently tweaking the walking while shooting animation and some other animations. What other polish would you suggest based on the trailer?

comments.author: Aineisa
comments.body:
Not good. Using AI means the expectations on polish is far higher and this fails. 

Dont ask us what needs to be polished. You’re the dev. Do the work. Make it better.

comments.author: Square-Yam-3772
comments.body:
I remember this game being a bare bone 2d game lol. 

this has the look of a meme-looking indie game right now... do you have anyone playing the current version? 

you should probably get the demo out there to gather some feedbacks first

replies.author: Romellija
replies.body:
Haha ya it started off really basic and crap. It's come an awful long way since then. I've only had a few friends play it so far who've given me some constructive feedback and it's ongoing but I'm gonna be looking if anyone else would like to this weekend probably and I'll try get a demo sorted aswell.

The game currently has 11 maps made up of 86 sections. A full playthrough should take about 4-6hours based off my own plays and using a bot play through so I definitely don't wanna seem like a meme type game

comments.author: _Fauxpaw
comments.body: I assume you're fine with not getting any sales, because this is not a good looking product.
